title: I love it but here is what to do to improve it
body:
So I really like the app but I have some things to help improve

1. Change the butterfly every time you do the butterfly scan to make it look more interesting.

2. Make food for the birb to make it more realistic and make it look fun.

3. During the butterfly scan, you can put your birb with the butterfly on it to so that you can do the butterfly scan together.

Overall 5 stars but those are just some ideas to improve the game. But it’s super relaxing.

title: Words can't describe how amazing this app is
body:
I have been looking for an app like this for the longest time. Its safe to say that it has helped me be at my best state of mental health in a long time. The way this app motivates you to complete your tasks is effective, and more importantly guilt free. Not only do you have mood check ins, you can also set goals and reflect on the stuff going on around you. I must say this helped me be more self aware. 

The finch is also really cute, you can't help bit feel responsible for the little guy. The app rewards the finch whenever you complete your tasks by making it grow. I am using the free version as of now, but I am considering paying for a subscription because I believe it will be worth it. You can tell whoever made this app cares about helping people's mental health as you get many free tools.

 My only suggestion for an improvement for this app is to allow goals to be automatically on repeat daily/weekly, as it can get a bit tedious to manually add them in daily.
